name: circleup-platform
description: CircleUp Thrift-Commerce, Rental & Community Platform Monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@circleup/shared && npm run build --workspace=@circleup/backend && npm run build --workspace=@circleup/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=@circleup/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=@circleup/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=@circleup/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=@circleup/backend && npm run test --workspace=@circleup/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=@circleup/backend && npm run lint --workspace=@circleup/frontend
